# Oracles for the vLLM speculative-decoding argument.
#
# The operator renders spec.vllmConfig.speculative as one --speculative-config
# JSON document. These files are the pinned engine's own answer to "what may
# appear in that document", captured from the upstream source, so the test
# asserts against vLLM's parser rather than against our reading of it (#1031).
#
# spec-fields.txt
#   Source: vllm-project/vllm @ tag v0.25.1 (the tag VLLMBackend.DefaultImage
#   pins, vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1), file vllm/config/speculative.py,
#   `class SpeculativeConfig` through the last field (line ~230).
#   Extracted with:
#     gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' \
#       'repos/vllm-project/vllm/contents/vllm/config/speculative.py?ref=v0.25.1' \
#       | awk '/^class SpeculativeConfig:/{f=1} f && /^    [a-z_]+:/ {split($1,a,":"); print a[1]} f && /^RejectionSampleMethod/ {exit}'
#
#   The class is a pydantic dataclass built by vllm/config/utils.py:69
#   (ConfigDict(extra="forbid")), so a key outside this list is a startup
#   error, not a warning. That is why only keys present here are typed:
#   enable_adaptive_verification exists in v0.32.0 only.
enforce_eager
num_speculative_tokens
model
method
draft_tensor_parallel_size
tensor_parallel_size
quantization
moe_backend
attention_backend
max_model_len
revision
code_revision
disable_padded_drafter_batch
use_local_argmax_reduction
use_heterogeneous_vocab
prompt_lookup_max
prompt_lookup_min
parallel_drafting
target_model_config
target_parallel_config
num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size
draft_model_config
draft_parallel_config
suffix_decoding_max_tree_depth
suffix_decoding_max_cached_requests
suffix_decoding_max_spec_factor
suffix_decoding_min_token_prob
draft_load_config
rejection_sample_method
synthetic_acceptance_rates
synthetic_acceptance_length
draft_sample_method
